title: agentbay.config.yaml
description: Per-project user settings. modes.<name> is validated against that mode's config schema; connectors.<name> against the connector's config schema. Settings can only tighten mode constraints and env limits (strictest wins).

bindings.description: Per-env connector rebinding: <env> -> <interface>/v<N> -> connector | [connectors]. Re-validated like the env itself; cannot widen network, secrets or fs.
